sections.title: Scope & Overview
content: This Privacy Policy applies to all mobile games, mobile utility applications (including **Dubai Modern Bus Simulator**, **ScanPro – QR & Barcode Scanner**, and upcoming releases), digital products, and services published by **Coreplay Technologies** ("we", "our", or "us") on Google Play and authorized Android marketplaces.

We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data practices. Our core philosophy is privacy-by-design: we minimize data collection, process sensitive hardware operations (such as camera scanning) strictly on-device, and never harvest, sell, or monetize your personal files or scan history.

sections.title: Device Permissions & Hardware Access
content: To deliver core utility and gaming capabilities, our applications may request access to specific Android device hardware and system features. These permissions are requested at runtime only when strictly needed:

- **Camera Access (android.permission.CAMERA):** Used exclusively in our scanner utilities (such as ScanPro) to provide a real-time viewfinder for scanning QR codes and 1D/2D barcodes using Google ML Kit. **Zero Cloud Transmission:** Video frames and images captured by your camera are analyzed strictly in real-time in your device's temporary memory. We do not record, store, upload, or transmit your camera video stream or captured photos to any external server.
- **Flashlight (android.permission.FLASHLIGHT):** Used optionally to toggle your device flashlight so you can scan barcodes and QR codes in dark or low-light conditions.

- **Photos, Media & File Storage (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / Filesystem):** Used only when you voluntarily choose to scan an existing QR code or barcode from your saved device photo gallery, or when you explicitly export your scan history logs (such as CSV or text files) or save generated QR codes to your local device storage.

- **System Clipboard Access:** Enables you to copy decoded barcode data, Wi-Fi passwords, or URLs to your device clipboard with a single tap, or paste text to generate custom QR codes. Clipboard data is processed locally and never transmitted to our servers.
- **Haptic Feedback & Vibration (VIBRATE):** Used to provide immediate tactile vibration confirmation upon successful detection of a barcode or QR code.

- **Network & Internet State (INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE):** Used to deliver advertisements via verified ad networks, check license verification via Google Play, and open external web links in your preferred browser when you tap on a scanned URL.
You can manage, grant, or revoke any of these permissions at any time through your Android device settings (**Settings > Apps > [App Name] > Permissions**).

sections.title: Information Collection and Use
content: When you download, install, and interact with our applications and games, certain technical and diagnostic data may be automatically collected:
- **Device Technical Identifiers:** Device model, manufacturer, Android operating system version, system language, screen resolution, and available memory.
- **Diagnostic & Performance Data:** Application launch timestamps, session duration, in-game level progress, crash logs, and stability metrics.
- **Advertising Identifiers:** Non-permanent device identifiers such as the Google Advertising ID (GAID), used to measure advertising attribution and frequency capping.

- **Approximate Geographic Location:** Non-precise, coarse location derived from IP address (e.g. country or metropolitan area) used for regional advertising compliance, language localization, and fraud prevention. **We do not collect precise GPS coordinates.**

- **Local User Content & History:** In our scanner applications (ScanPro), your scan history logs, favorites, generated codes, and user preferences are stored **strictly locally on your device** (via local app preferences). They are never synced to our servers without your explicit action.

sections.title: Third-Party Services & SDK Integrations
content: Our applications and games integrate trusted third-party Software Development Kits (SDKs) to provide operating system connectivity, on-device machine learning, advertising monetization, and performance stability. Each provider processes data in accordance with their respective privacy policies:
- **Google Play Services (Google LLC):** Essential for Android app distribution, security verification, and operating system integration. [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)

- **Google AdMob & Mobile Ads SDK (Google LLC):** Delivers banner, interstitial, and rewarded video advertisements. AdMob may collect and process device advertising IDs (GAID), IP address, and interaction data to serve relevant ads and prevent fraud. [Google AdMob Privacy Policy](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543)

- **Google ML Kit (Google LLC):** Powers high-speed on-device computer vision for barcode and QR code recognition. Machine learning inference occurs 100% locally on your phone's processor without sending image frames to Google servers. [Google ML Kit Terms](https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms)

- **Unity Technologies (Unity Ads & Engine):** Provides 3D graphics rendering, realistic physics simulation, and in-game ad delivery for mobile games. [Unity Privacy Policy](https://unity.com/legal/privacy-policy)

- **Firebase & Crashlytics (Google LLC):** Aggregated crash analytics and performance monitoring used to troubleshoot device-specific crashes and optimize frame rates. [Firebase Privacy Policy](https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy)

sections.title: Managing Advertising Choices & Advertising ID
content: Our free-to-download mobile games and utility apps may display advertisements powered by Google AdMob and certified ad networks. You have complete control over personalized advertising through your Android operating system settings:
- **Reset Advertising ID:** Open Android **Settings > Google > Ads** and tap **Reset advertising ID** to disassociate past activity from your device identifier.

- **Delete Advertising ID:** On modern Android versions (Android 12+), navigate to **Settings > Google > Ads** and tap **Delete advertising ID** to prevent apps from accessing your advertising identifier entirely.
- **Opt-Out of Personalized Ads:** Toggle **Opt out of Ads Personalization** in your Google settings to ensure you receive contextual ads rather than interest-based ads.

sections.title: In-App Purchases & Financial Data
content: If our games or applications offer optional in-app purchases, digital unlocks, or subscriptions, all payment transactions are handled exclusively through the **Google Play In-App Billing** system.

Coreplay Technologies does not collect, receive, or store your credit card numbers, bank account information, or billing address. All financial details are processed securely by Google under [Google Payments Privacy Notice](https://payments.google.com/legaldocument?family=0.privacynotice).

sections.title: Data Retention & User Data Deletion Rights
content: In compliance with Google Play Store Developer Policies and international privacy regulations, we provide clear procedures for managing and deleting your data:

- **Local Data Erasure:** You can permanently delete your scan history, favorite items, and cached preferences instantly at any time from within the app by navigating to **Settings > Clear History** or through Android system settings (**Settings > Apps > Storage > Clear Data**).

- **Account & Server Data Deletion Request:** If you have contacted our support team or submitted diagnostic feedback, you have the right to request the permanent erasure of all associated correspondence and records.

- **How to Request Deletion:** Send an email to **{{contactEmail}}** with the subject line **[Data Deletion Request]** specifying the application name and your details. We verify and complete all data deletion requests within 30 days without charge.

sections.title: Children's Privacy & Families Policy
content: Coreplay Technologies complies with the **Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)**, GDPR-K, and Google Play Families Policies.

Our applications and games are designed for general audiences and are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the European Economic Area). We do not knowingly solicit, collect, or store personal information from children under 13 years of age.

If we become aware that personal information has been mistakenly collected from a child under 13 without verifiable parental consent, we will take immediate steps to permanently remove such data from our systems. Parents and legal guardians may contact us directly at **{{contactEmail}}** for prompt assistance.

sections.title: Your Global Privacy Rights (GDPR & CCPA/CPRA)
content: Depending on your geographic jurisdiction, you hold specific legal rights concerning your personal data:

- **European Economic Area (EEA) & UK Users (GDPR):** You have the right to access your personal data, request rectification of inaccurate data, request erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"), restrict or object to data processing, and request data portability.

- **California Residents (CCPA / CPRA):** You have the right to know what personal information is collected, request deletion of your information, and be free from discriminatory treatment for exercising your rights.
- **"Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information":** Coreplay Technologies **does not sell, rent, or trade** personal information to third parties for monetary or valuable consideration.
To exercise any of these statutory rights, please contact our privacy representative at **{{contactEmail}}**.

sections.title: Offline Functionality & Privacy by Design
content: Our utility applications (such as ScanPro) and offline game modes are designed to operate independently of an active internet connection whenever possible.

All barcode scanning, QR code decoding, and code generation calculations execute entirely locally on your device hardware without requiring an internet connection. Your scanned data remains your private property on your physical device.

sections.title: Data Security
content: We implement industry-standard technical, procedural, and administrative safeguards to protect any diagnostic information collected against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. All communication with third-party service providers (such as Google Play and AdMob) is encrypted in transit using Transport Layer Security (TLS/HTTPS).

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
content: We may update our Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our applications, newly published titles, operating system requirements, or legal regulations. We will notify you of any revisions by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.

We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how Coreplay Technologies protects your information. Continued use of our mobile applications and games after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.title: Contact Us
content: If you have any questions, suggestions, or data requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the privacy practices of Coreplay Technologies, please contact our Privacy Team:
- **Developer / Publisher:** Coreplay Technologies
- **Support & Privacy Email:** {{contactEmail}}
- **Google Play Profile:** [Coreplay Technologies on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6807992577867877190)
- **Response Time:** We strive to acknowledge and resolve all privacy inquiries within 48 to 72 business hours.
